items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I was supposed to take a clarinet lesson with Lorenzo Teal. Oh, yeah. But instead of me going to take my lesson on the clarinet...

ctx.x: Now, what was that neighborhood like around Anderson's?

Oh, it was sort of a nightclub. Was that the one on Rampart Street? That's the one that was on Rampart Street Canal in Iberville. Yeah. And another one was in the old Tenderline District there on Basin Street. Basin and Iberville. That was the relation. Is that the one they called the Annex? Did they call that the Annex? Annex. The Annex. I was wondering more about when you first started on drums. Did you have a teacher right away, an old man Contrell, or did you just pick it up first yourself? Or how come you…
How did you take drum lessons from him? Did you have a drum or did you use his drum?
